name: NPS: Non-Player-Soul
shortDescription: Local-first runtime for living game NPCs: a Unity package that gives characters memory, personality and tools, with the engine keeping the final say.
description:
NPS is the base of a reusable, plug-and-play NPC runtime for Unity. The language model isn't the game engine: it's a constrained planner and dialogue layer, and Unity owns sensing, validation, movement and every state change. Many NPCs share one local model behind a sidecar; each keeps its own profile, memories, goals and tool permissions.

Highlights:
- A portable runtime MVP: agent and command loops, typed tools with an authoring API, world-rule validation, world-state and memory types, and local model providers.
- A typed-command bank sample scene for the first proving game, Bobbie & Claude, a small bank robbery where you talk your AI partner through guards and keycards.
- An evaluation harness with traces, provider smoke tests and trial reports, so behaviour can be compared across models.
